epsilon_origin: research design allocation for first E_cap in a seven-day retained-buffer window; not a norm or system allocation
selection_rule: fixed connected seven-day interval containing the 8 June 2024 proton event named in NOAA reports, selected before policy outcomes
historical_independence: not asserted: project had broader GOES history; new frozen policy test, not proven historically unseen data
prior_studies_excluded_from_tuning: ISSI neutron/grouped rate and timing data
model_class: two-state Markov-modulated independent singleton Poisson, uniform word and bit labels; nonsymmetric transition rates estimated from training only
initial_mode_law: stationary law of frozen training-fit Q, not forced (0.5,0.5), independent of test history
nominal_historical_law: piecewise-constant singleton NHPP driven by reconstructed GOES proton plus separately ACE/COSRAD-reconstructed ion bit-first-moment rates
primary_estimands: 2 preregistered reconstruction sensitivities: Proposed and Strong Fixed risk
statistical_goal: order 0.002 absolute risk half-width near epsilon for simultaneous risk intervals; actual exact intervals reported, not guaranteed width
precomputed_class: all two-block schedules with one fixed split at H/2; 12x12 candidates, plus fixed grid; none knows event onset

engineering_threshold.scope: absolute design threshold chosen before outcomes; only J-conditional effect unless explicit post-error operating policy added

numerical_contract: must be rebuilt after actual rates/Q; no copied 0.0002 or 0.0003 reserve; no certificate issued in A
freezing_order: derive training-only parameters and cheap reference floor
freeze final numerical contract and all policies; publish before test
